issues.problem: The REPORT calls the replacement of « V para-compact » a reading and leaves 'does V Hausdorff force B Hausdorff' open. It is answered. For V = {z>0,(x,y)≠0}/⟨diag(4,1/8,2)⟩ ⊂ ℝ³ (Hausdorff, second countable, hence paracompact), B is not Hausdorff, so V → B has no section (t2Space_of_section) and V ≇ B × ℝ₊*. Benzécri's p. 241 inference « si V est supposé para-compact, on peut donc construire une section » is false. The cited theorem needs a normal base, and paracompactness of V does not supply it. For n ≤ 2 it is true.
issues.fix: Record it under `findings` (DEC-27, or under ruling R2): 'p. 241 and Déf. 3: false without B séparé (⇔ proper ℝ₊* action); counterexample n = 3; true for n ≤ 2'. Change SCOPE bullet 3 from 'open question' to the answer.

issues.problem: The paper's hypothesis is on V (paracompact). Under F6, V is connected, and a connected, locally compact, paracompact Hausdorff V is σ-compact. So B (σ-compact, locally compact, and Hausdorff by assumption) is paracompact. A variant with [ParacompactSpace V] [ConnectedSpace V] [T2Space B] would be the closest true form of p. 241.
